response.sql: WITH prof AS (SELECT o.weathprofile AS weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_band, COUNT(*) AS n_tel FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_band) AS mean_avg FROM prof) SELECT prof.weathprofile, prof.avg_band AS avg_bandwidth_usage, prof.n_tel AS telescope_count, prof.avg_band - m.mean_avg AS diff_from_mean FROM prof CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL
